outcome_analysis.explanation: The official completed status records mark both attempts failed with the same 104 of 163 samples passing. The parallel-configured run did not actually use a child-agent mechanism, so there is no parallel coordination episode that can explain an outcome gap. Both attempts produced minimal behavior-driven ESM implementations and both were insufficient for the hidden official cases.
parallel_contributors: Multi-agent mode was enabled, but protocol validation shows no spawn calls, no child threads, and no child activity, making this a single-actor solution attempt.
The parent implemented a broader local module tree and reported a 16-case comparison matrix before finalizing.
serial_contributors: The serial attempt also used one actor and produced a compact local ESM module tree.
It visibly verified fewer post-write Node cases while still targeting the same observed argparse and schema behavior.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The visible differences are ordinary implementation and verification choices: module granularity and breadth of local checks, not multi-agent coordination.
The pair inputs do not expose hidden failed testcase details, so the exact shared missing behavior behind 59 failed samples cannot be resolved without leaving the allowed inputs.
evaluator_effects: The evaluator result is identical for both attempts, so no evaluator-side discordance needs explanation.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference and no retained parallel-side coordination pattern
